svg.text: Firefighter Service — Two Phases, Two Very Different Behaviors
Mandatory per ASME A17.1 for every elevator traveling 25+ ft above the lowest fire department access level.
Triggered by lobby key switch OR automatic

g.text: • ALL cars recall to main landing (or alternate if
• Cars above main REVERSE, return without stopping
• Doors open and stay open at the main landing

svg.text: Key must stay in RECALL to hold cars — OFF/BYPASS restores normal service.
Activated by a key switch inside the car —

g.text: • Responds ONLY to car-operating panel; hall calls ignored
• Doors do NOT open automatically — hold DOOR OPEN
• Doors do NOT close automatically — hold DOOR CLOSE

svg.text: Obstruction while closing → doors reopen, stay open
Automatic door closing during rescue operations could trap a firefighter — the immediate-reopen behavior
removes that risk entirely, even in emergency-service mode.
Phase II is fire department use only — building personnel should never operate an elevator during a fire
event, even if it appears to be in normal Phase II standby.
